sources.title: IES: Organizing Instruction and Study to Improve Student Learning
sources.finding: The education practice guide supports combining examples with practice, diagrams with concise explanations, and concrete with abstract representations. It does not test poker apps or establish retention gains for this redesign.
sources.decision: Teach cards and table roles visually before notation/math; show a worked example, then a varied question. Apply as design inference, not measured app efficacy.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: Recognition and Recall
sources.finding: Visible choices and contextual cues reduce dependence on memory.
sources.decision: Use meaningful button labels, visible chart access and one-tap beginner choices; avoid unexplained abbreviations. Choice questions still require useful distractors and transfer checks.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: Progressive Disclosure
sources.finding: Secondary complexity can be exposed when needed rather than dominating initial views.
sources.decision: Compact hints, optional deeper math, expandable statistics and compact preferences; retain essential instructions in visible teaching content.

sources.title: Apple HIG: Sheets
sources.finding: Sheets serve scoped contextual tasks. Back navigates within a hierarchy; Close dismisses.
sources.decision: Use a short contextual sheet for short help, native push navigation for hierarchy and explicit Previous for lesson steps. Do not reinterpret every modal as a back gesture.

sources.title: PokerStars: Hand Rankings
sources.finding: Holdem compares the best five cards, with category and all relevant tie-breakers. A flush beats a straight; a straight beats three of a kind.
sources.decision: Use valid varied hand comparisons and group river cards by actual comparison outcome rather than rank alone.

sources.title: PokerStars Learn: Position
sources.finding: The button and blinds locate action order; preflop begins after the big blind and later streets begin with the first active player left of the dealer. Seat naming varies with table size.
sources.decision: Teach the app’s eight-seat example directly; separate posting blinds from taking a turn; note heads-up is a special case rather than forcing eight-seat rules everywhere.

sources.title: Duolingo: Learning with hearing impairment
sources.finding: Official screenshots/documentation list separate Sound effects and Haptic feedback preferences under Lesson experience.
sources.decision: Use independent switches once actual effects exist; this is a structural reference, not adoption of Duolingo tone/rewards.

sources.title: Signal Support: Chat Colors, Wallpaper, and Themes
sources.finding: Theme options are grouped under Appearance rather than permanently occupying multiple main-page rows.
sources.decision: Use compact value rows for language/appearance lower on Settings.

sources.title: Apple HIG: Dark Mode
sources.finding: Appearance can follow system changes; explicit light/dark support must remain coherent.
sources.decision: Preserve System/Light/Dark choices; compact controls must not reduce them to an ambiguous binary setting.

sources.title: Apple HIG: Playing haptics
sources.finding: Apple recommends an opt-out and an experience that works without haptics.
sources.decision: Centralize app-generated feedback behind one setting; preserve visible outcomes and respect system behavior.

sources.title: W3C WAI: Timing Adjustable
sources.finding: Content that disappears on a timer can exclude people who need more reading time; equivalent persistent access changes the timing concern.
sources.decision: Do not make essential lesson instruction available only in a 2–3 second popup. Use persistent reopenable help; a nonessential reminder may be transient.

sources.title: NN/g: Consistency and Standards
sources.finding: Consistent language, layout and behavior help people predict controls and results.
sources.decision: Use one feedback structure and app voice; keep Back/Close/Previous distinct; validate localized names by actual width, not character count alone.

sources.title: Apple HIG: Labels
sources.finding: Labels establish context and describe possible next actions.
sources.decision: Name Free Play tabs by purpose and separate pause, end and new-game actions.

limits: External guidance informs proposals; no new novice study, retention experiment or native verification was conducted for HTML designs.
